items.line: Rob Gronkowski's spike shattered the ball into pieces on live TV. Chaotic, C-Tier.
Chad Johnson pulled out a fake Hall of Fame jacket after scoring. Bold, B-Tier.
Terrell Owens pulled a Sharpie from his sock and signed the ball on live TV. Iconic, A-Tier.
But Randy Moss mooning the entire Packers crowd? Legendary, S-Tier. Nobody ever topped it.
